verdict.rationale: Brex is a corporate-card and spend-management platform focused on accounts-payable (bill pay, vendor payments, expense automation) — all evidence (brex-docs-7, brex-docs-12, brex-docs-14) is about paying vendors, not collecting from customers. Automated dunning/follow-up on overdue receivables is an accounts-receivable capability outside Brex's product category, so this axis does not apply.
